title: parquetDatastore
summary: Create a parquet datastore descriptor object.
description: `parquetDatastore(files)` creates a descriptor object with a `Files` property for parquet table workflows.
behaviors: The constructor preserves file specifications for code that passes datastore descriptors around.
Parquet decoding and iterator-style operations such as `read`, `hasdata`, and `reset` require the generic datastore dispatch layer and are not provided by this constructor builtin.
